subject: Data retention carveout for Medexa — sample purge verification & evidence handoff
messages:
From: Sana Rao <sana.rao@medexa.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: John Patel <john.patel@medexa.com>, Medexa Legal <legal@medexa.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick: sample purge verification + artifacts for SOC2 review

Hi Priyom / Kimberly —

As part of our SOC2 readiness review we need to validate a model of tenant-scoped log disposal for one of our regulated sandboxes. Specifically we need:

- A short description of how Redwood performs a targeted purge of "ephemeral session traces" (what we call a sample purge) when a customer confirms deletion.
- Evidence that the purge completed (hash or manifest) for 3 customer sessions we will point to — can be a CSV manifest plus a signed checksum.
- The retention matrix showing which debug traces are kept vs. permanently erased, and where immutable audit snapshots (if any) live.

Constraints: we cannot accept an export that contains raw PII. Where possible, we want an attested proof-of-delete workflow (signed by Redwood) and a secure link to any artifact.

Can you confirm what artifacts you can provide and an ETA? Happy to set a short call if this is easier.

Thanks,
Sana Rao
Director, Compliance
Medexa Therapeutics

Attachments: none

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sana Rao <sana.rao@medexa.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick: sample purge verification + artifacts for SOC2 review

Sana —

Thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: we can provide a small, redacted evidence bundle plus a signed manifest and a timestamped audit export. Plan outline:

1) For each sample session you point to, we will produce:
   - medexa_sample_manifest.csv (session id, timestamp, SHA256 of the exported record, redaction flag)
   - retention_policy_matrix.pdf (mapping of trace categories -> retention action)
   - audit_export_20261207.zip (contains audit log of the delete operation and the storage tombstone entries; PII redacted)

2) Technical notes: targeted purges operate against tenant-scoped ephemeral traces and KV prefix cache. The runtime marks records with a tombstone and initiates an immediate KVS delete + background S3 object rewrite where required. We also keep a 45-day immutable audit snapshot (S3 WORM) for the audit trail; the snapshot does NOT contain raw transcript PII — only metadata and hashes necessary for verification.

3) Deliverables & compliance posture:
   - Signed manifest (SHA256) — we will sign using Redwood internal signing key and include the signature file.
   - Proof-of-delete: audit_export contains the delete operation id, operator id, and storage references.

ETA: preliminary bundle available EOD tomorrow (Tue 12/08). Final signed packet by Thu 12/10 after legal review.

Is there a preferred secure transport? We can deliver via a pre-signed S3 link with IP-restricted access or upload to your compliance Drive.

—Priyom
Lead, Customer Compliance & Evidence
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Sana Rao <sana.rao@medexa.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick: sample purge verification + artifacts for SOC2 review

Sana/Priyom — adding the engineering side and what's realistically in the audit export.

Technical summary (concise):
- The purge workflow: 1) API request accepted with tenant id + deletion token; 2) runtime invalidates prefix caches (KV) and issues synchronized delete to primary blobstore; 3) background job reconciles replicas and emits an "erase_complete" event to the audit log.
- Audit export (audit_export_20261207.zip) will contain:
   * erase_complete events (JSONL) with event_id, session_id (hashed), timestamp, operator, and storage_object_id (opaque id)
   * tombstone markers (S3 object keys) and associated checksum 
   * reconciliation job logs (truncate) showing successful GC runs

We will ensure session IDs in the bundle are hashed (salted) per Medexa's PII constraints. The manifest will show the mapping (hashed id -> proof hash) but not the raw transcript.

Attachments we will include as stubs in the bundle:
- medexa_sample_manifest.csv (CSV)
- retention_policy_matrix.pdf (PDF)
- audit_export_20261207.zip (ZIP; contains JSONL files)

If you want a cryptographic attestation (timestamp + signature) we can produce that; it will be signed by our key and we can include the public key cert chain.

Ben Carter
Sr. Engineer, Runtime Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: medexa_sample_manifest.csv, retention_policy_matrix.pdf, audit_export_20261207.zip

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sana Rao <sana.rao@medexa.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick: sample purge verification + artifacts for SOC2 review

Sana —

Thanks — this aligns with what SOC2 reviewers expect. A couple of compliance-level notes:

- The retention_policy_matrix.pdf will explicitly call out categories (ephemeral session traces, debug telemetry, aggregated metrics, KV cache) and the action (immediate delete, 7-day quarantine, 45-day immutable audit snapshot).
- We will include a short attestation letter (signed PDF) from Redwood's Compliance team confirming that the artifacts were generated from the production tenant-scoped pipeline and that PII was redacted per Medexa's requirements.
- Delivery: we propose the secure S3 presigned link with IP restriction + a one-time passphrase delivered out-of-band (we can send the passphrase to your security Slack or via DocuSign envelope).

I'll coordinate legal sign-off on the attestation once Priyom confirms the final manifest.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Compliance Governance
Redwood Inference

From: Sana Rao <sana.rao@medexa.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: John Patel <john.patel@medexa.com>, Medexa Legal <legal@medexa.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 15:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick: sample purge verification + artifacts for SOC2 review

Team —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clarity. Medexa prefers the S3 presigned + IP restriction approach; please set expiry to 72 hours. Two small asks before you produce the signed attestation:

1) Can you include a short paragraph in the attestation stating that the 45-day immutable audit snapshot contains only metadata and cryptographic hashes (no raw customer transcripts)? This helps our auditors.
2) For the three sample sessions we will send the IDs (in hashed form) by EOD today. Once we have the bundle we'll run our internal verifier and confirm.

Also request: please add DocuSign-ready attestation (PDF) so our legal team can countersign. If you can drop the presigned link to your Drive + the HS record id in that packet, that would help us map it to our compliance ticketing.

Sana
Director, Compliance
Medexa Therapeutics

--
Requested sample ids (hashed): 7f3a9c2b, aa9f45d2, 3b8e1f07
